patches.reason: currentChoices holds the action names offered in a round, and then the position of the chosen action, which the rest of the round reads. A TeaseScript variable keeps one type, so the position goes into its own variable, chosenAction, which starts at 0 for a choice that names no action (the list itself then, which the lookups that follow could not use).

updateNumbers takes the three number lists as an untyped parameter, so the conversion cannot prove it a list and dropped `nums=nums+(nums.last()+5)`: the list shrank each round, and the next `nums[1..4]` read past its end. Every caller passes a list, so the parameter is declared List, which Groovy treats the same for these calls.
